scope: Assigned frozen titles and complete ItemBodies, local rendered HTML, and every assigned screenshot tile; no live routes.

review_method.normative_instructions: CLAUDE.md read fully; README.md read fully; assignment and capture receipts were read locally.
review_method.rendering: Every assigned local PNG tile was opened individually with tools.view_image at original resolution; no collage or downscaling.
review_method.source_snapshot_html: Every assigned frozen title and full ItemBody was reviewed in its snapshot and compared with the byte-identical current source, assigned HTML, capture receipt, and screenshot tiles.
review_method.boundary: No item, application, or publication-status edits; no builds, tests, gates, commits, pushes, or network calls. Only lane-04.md and lane-04.json were written.

optional_typography.observation: Reference links appearing as separate lines/blocks and long mathematical prose wrapping across lines were not treated as defects. No literal TeX/KaTeX or TikZ source, malformed glyphs, or source-independent display corruption was confirmed.

diagram_candidates.rationale: The source explicitly calls the stage equations a stage graph and states that each stage is formed from preceding slopes, with a final weighted endpoint.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Draw the admitted base (t,y), then stages i=1,…,s in increasing order. For each i show (t_i,Y_i)→K_i=f(t_i,Y_i), with incoming arrows from each j<i labeled h a_ij; show t_i=t+c_i h and Y_i=y+hΣ_{j<i}a_ijK_j. Connect all K_i to y^+=y+hΣ_i b_iK_i. Do not draw dependencies from j≥i, and mark stage pair domain failure/evaluation failure as status branches if statuses are included.
diagram_candidates.status: Optional; the equations are complete and the proof does not rely on a diagram.

diagram_candidates.rationale: The source defines a C/F partition, interpolation P, restriction R, exact coarse Schur complement, practical coarse solve, and pre/post relaxations in an ordered cycle.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Show N fine intervals partitioned into m-step coarse intervals, with C nodes at multiples jm and F nodes between them. Label P as coarse correction interpolation and R as residual restriction; label the exact coarse operator R A_t P= A_CC−A_CF A_FF^{-1}A_FC. Show the cycle order pre-relaxation → residual restriction → A_c z=ρ with z_0=0 and z_j=ρ_j+Ψ_j z_{j−1} → correction u←u+Pz → post-relaxation. Keep the exact Schur operator distinct from practical A_c.
diagram_candidates.status: Optional; it would clarify declared operators and order, with no proof dependence.

diagram_candidates.kind: hybrid mode/guard/reset transition graph with event-time strip
diagram_candidates.rationale: The algorithm explicitly processes outgoing mode transitions, isolates and orients guard roots, selects the earliest enabled root with fixed-priority tie handling, applies a reset, and restarts in a target mode.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Show a current mode m with smooth-flow segment on [a,b], each outgoing transition (m,n) labeled by guard g_mn=0 and orientation σ_mn; distinguish strictly opposite-oriented roots (no transition) from enabled candidates. Show earliest certified event selection, priority only for certified common-time ties, reset R into target mode n, and restart at reported upper endpoint τ̂ with ledger E updated by the displayed bound. Include no-event, inconclusive, domain-failure, and budget-exhausted outcomes only as status exits.
diagram_candidates.status: Optional; diagram must preserve certification and tie semantics and cannot infer event absence from endpoint signs.

diagram_candidates.rationale: The algorithm gives exact state updates, exponential waiting times, cumulative propensity channel selection, absorption, horizon, and finite-budget prefix statuses.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: For a small explicitly supplied reaction network, draw states x∈E with each channel j arrow x→x+ν_j labeled a_j(x); annotate total exit rate λ(x)=Σ_j a_j(x), waiting time τ=E_{n+1}/λ(x), and channel selection by cumulative propensity intervals in U_{n+1}. Show λ=0 as absorption, t+τ≥T as horizon, and budget exhaustion as an incomplete path prefix. Never imply this ideal random source is a finite pseudorandom generator.
diagram_candidates.status: Optional; select a concrete finite network from an example before drawing; the generic algorithm needs no diagram.

diagram_candidates.rationale: The source combines growth characteristics, a nonlocal daughter-size kernel, mortality/removal, and absorbing outflow at X.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Show a parent of size y moving along χ_y with velocity g(x) toward X; mark survival/removal rate μ+γ and absorbing exit at X. From division at y, draw a daughter-size measure K_y supported on [0,y] feeding ν_t at daughter sizes x; distinguish this nonlocal birth-production term from the parent transport characteristic. Show no incoming boundary source at x=0.
diagram_candidates.status: Optional; use measure-valued labels to allow atoms and avoid suggesting a density exists.
